PZZ700-240830-
1203 PM PST Mon Nov 23 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1015 mb low was over north-central Arizona, a 967 mb 
low was over the Gulf of Alaska, and a 1021 mb high was 350
nautical miles west of San Diego. Weak onshore flow today will 
transition to weak offshore flow Tuesday morning, followed by a 
weak sea breeze Tuesday afternoon. Onshore flow strengthens 
Wednesday with gusts near 20-25 knots in the outer waters in the 
afternoon and evening. Combined seas increase to 8-12 feet in the 
outer waters late Wednesday into Thursday. Seas will begin to 
lower on Friday and into the following weekend.
